prompt:
High-fidelity desktop web app UI screenshot, product design mockup, 1536x1024. App name 灵犀 (Lingxi), a local hub that connects several AI coding agents. Visual direction: celadon porcelain and ink, calm and precise, Chinese scholar aesthetic but modern product UI. Palette strictly: app background pale celadon #EEF2EE, panels paper white #FBFCFA, text ink #16201C, muted moss gray #5D6B64, primary deep celadon green #2E6B5E, a single brass gold accent #B7832F used only for small knots and attention dots. Hairline borders #DCE3DE, 8px radius, very soft shadows, generous whitespace.

Layout: a slim left navigation rail (light, not dark) with the brand 灵犀 set in an elegant Chinese serif at top and six short items with thin line icons: 今日, 工作线, 会话, 消息, 日报, 状态 (今日 selected with a celadon tint). Top bar: page title '今日' in Chinese serif, the date in small gray text, and on the right a search field showing 'Ctrl K'.

SIGNATURE HERO (full width card, the most important element): a 'loom' timeline called 今日织机. Horizontal time axis from 08:00 to 20:00 with faint vertical hour lines. Five horizontal lanes, one per AI agent, each labeled at left with a small colored dot and short name: Claude Code (terracotta #D97757), Codex (green #10A37F), pi (violet #6E56CF), 豆包 (amber #E5A000), WorkBuddy (blue #1C8AD6). In each lane, smooth colored threads (rounded thick lines) span the hours when that agent's sessions were active, some lanes have two or three thread segments. Small brass gold knots sit on threads where notes were saved. Thin curved dashed connectors arc between lanes showing messages passed from one agent to another, with tiny arrowheads. A thin vertical 'now' line near 16:30. It looks like woven threads, elegant, data-accurate, not decorative.

Below the loom, two columns. Left column (wider): card 'needs attention' style list with 3 rows: an unread message from pi, a project with uncommitted changes showing '3 files changed', a handoff updated. Then a card listing projects with rows showing project folder name, git branch pill, and small agent dots. Right column: card '在线' listing 3 online agent sessions as compact rows each with a pulsing colored dot, a label like 'pi-research' and a gray path; below it a card of recent topics with titles in serif.

No marketing hero, no big stat number tiles, no gradients, no emoji, no fake logos. Clean readable product UI, realistic browser rendering, crisp text.

High-fidelity desktop web app UI screenshot, product design mockup, 1536x1024, same design system as a celadon-and-ink knowledge app named 灵犀. Palette strictly: background pale celadon #EEF2EE, panels paper white #FBFCFA, ink text #16201C, muted moss gray #5D6B64, primary deep celadon #2E6B5E, brass gold accent #B7832F used sparingly. Hairline borders #DCE3DE, 8px radius, soft shadows.

Screen: a topic (work stream) detail page. Slim light left navigation rail with brand 灵犀 in Chinese serif and items 今日, 工作线 (selected), 会话, 消息, 日报, 状态. Next to it a narrow list column of topics: each item has a serif title, a gray meta line with counts, the selected one highlighted with a celadon left bar.

Main area like a reading document: topic title in a large elegant Chinese serif, a muted one-line description, a meta row with a folder path in monospace and small agent dots, and underline tabs: 概览, 时间线, 交接包历史. The central column is a handoff document rendered beautifully: a small caption line with author agent pill (violet 'pi') and time, then a serif document title, then well-typeset sections with headings and bullet lists, comfortable 70-character line length, like a quality editorial reading view.

Right margin column styled as marginalia (side notes) beside the document: knowledge cards grouped by type, each card is a small note with a thin colored top edge and a tiny type label: 决策 (celadon), 约束 (muted red), 发现 (green), 踩坑 (gray with strikethrough label), 待办 (brass). Below them a small list of recent sessions with agent color dots.

No emoji, no gradients, no big number tiles. Crisp, readable, realistic browser UI, calm and precise.
